topics.inclusion_rule: Reused published table: studies that synthesize a speech waveform from talking-face or lip video and report the acoustic representation and how it becomes a waveform; enhancement with noisy audio at test, talking-head generation, text-only lip reading and video-to-text-to-TTS excluded; versions once.
topics.metric: LRS3 ASR WER, STOI-Net and DNSMOS

topics.inclusion_rule: The same 165-study population, classified by whether the waveform generator is trained together with the visual-to-acoustic path or is a pre-trained or separately trained vocoder, and whether a DDSP or harmonic-plus-noise signal model is used; a study counts under every design its full text names (upper bound); end-to-end training that stops at mel or units with a separate vocoder is not joint waveform training.
topics.metric: presence of the design; LRS3 WER and quality for state of the art

topics.inclusion_rule: The same 165-study population, classified by the speaker information supplied at use time: an embedding from reference audio, an embedding derived from the face or lip video, or none; training-only or scoring-only embeddings do not count; a study counts under every design its full text names (upper bound).

Reused published table: the same video-to-speech population, counting the evaluation protocols its full text names (listener test, ASR WER on output, unseen speakers, confidence intervals or tests, reference-free MOS predictors).
topics.metric: LRS3 WER under one ASR; listener MOS
